blocks.text: COTABATO CITY, Philippines — Rev. Fr. Gerry Gamaliel Sebastian Delos Reyes was appointed by Pope Leo XIV as the Apostolic Vicar of Jolo, the Oblates of Mary Immaculate (OMI) announced in a statement on Saturday. According to the OMI community, the Holy See press office made the appointment public at noon in Rome on Saturday, Nov. 21, or 7 p.m. Philippine time. The Catholic Bishops’ Conference of the Philippines said Delos Reyes, former superior of the OMI Philippine Province, will succeed Archbishop Charlie Inzon, who was appointed by Pope Leo XIV as the Metropolitan Archbishop of Cotabato on Sept. 8 last […]...
